skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Analyze general information about the internship unit (formation process, development, organizational structure, functions, tasks of the unit, main production and business activities, product/service characteristics, production technology processes, business environment of the internship unit)
Analyze the operating conditions of the internship unit, human resource characteristics, activities, roles, responsibilities of the human resources department of the internship unit
Conduct preliminary analysis of human resource management activities of the internship unit, determine the direction for development of the internship unit
Identify research problems within the field of human resource management at the internship unit
Develop a research proposal for the chosen topic
Select and build a theoretical framework for the research problem
Select and use research methods to implement the selected research topic
Evaluate the current status of the research problem based on the analysis of relevant data types
Propose solutions to address/improve the research problem of the internship unit
Demonstrate independent work skills, self-reliance, analytical synthesis, and problem-solving skills
Demonstrate research skills, presentation skills, writing reports on specialized issues in the field of human resource management

prerequisite_courses: Completed 75% of required credits in the program
